purpose: Version and compatibility pins, not engine performance evidence

inputs: Imported aligned feature lists for table-only comparison
Raw mzML/mzXML plus traces for full metaCorrelate route
MZmine.charge_policy: Configured ion types must match row polarity and charge. Explicitly test negative charge 2; preserve unsupported queries in coverage.
MZmine.runtime: Bundled JVM; official minimum 16 GB RAM/4 cores; academic macOS ARM artifact pinned; local launch/license not tested.
comparison_requirements: Set cutoff above complete lipid query range or disable it
Explicit polarity/adduct library and elemental ranges; no positive fallback for negative queries
Table-only and trace-supported routes scored separately
Hash final exported batch XML and record JVM/threads/memory/license before execution

SIRIUS.charge_policy: Official v6 documentation: singly charged monomers only; retain negative charge-2 queries as unsupported, not silently dropped.
SIRIUS.runtime: Bundled CLI/GUI on macOS ARM/x64, Linux and Windows; 16 GB recommended, about 2 GB/core. Local formula route distinct from licensed web services. Not launched.

defaults_inspected.adduct_fallback: Configured fallback set used when adduct unknown; raw preprocessing may propose several
defaults_inspected.same_ion_formula_adduct_ambiguity: Different neutral formula/adduct explanations may share ion composition and scores

comparison_requirements: Explicit fallback adducts; record unsupported charges and fragment/dimer handling
Freeze CLI options and any formula databases/model files before execution

inputs: m/z and polarity minimum; API or MGF with optional MS1 isotope pattern/MS/MS
msbuddy.charge_policy: Explicit supplied adduct required; wheel parser supports signed charges, but charge-2 end-to-end formula execution remains unverified. No adduct-identification comparison for this engine.
msbuddy.runtime: Separate Python 3.12 environment planned: repository guidance says >=3.9,<3.13 although wheel metadata only says >=3.8. Current LASER uses Python 3.13. Requires numba/LightGBM plus downloadable formula/model databases. No installation into LASER.
comparison_requirements: Pin isolated environment and downloaded databases/model hashes before execution
Enumerate external adduct hypotheses explicitly; no reference adduct supplied in joint-blind arm
Keep supplied-known-adduct formula arm separate from joint inference
Record timeouts and >1500 Da scope limitations as failures/unsupported on full query list

inputs: TSV: unique feature key, m/z, RT, per-sample intensities
Annotation TSV: annotation, mass, mode, charge, tier
Binner.charge_policy: Charges declared in annotation file; supported charge-2 behavior must pass synthetic conversion check before benchmark.
Binner.runtime: Java application; exact compatible JRE and local macOS launch remain unverified.
comparison_requirements: Obtain trusted JAR and SHA256 before execution; do not bypass TLS verification
Freeze JRE, annotation TSV, RT units, missing-value policy and correlation settings
Use all original features and identical specimen mapping; do not include group labels as inference features

inputs: IDSL.IPA chromatographic/isotope profile outputs plus prioritized formula space
IDSL.UFA.charge_policy: Adduct/charge settings in method input; detailed support/defaults remain to be verified before optional trace-stage execution.
IDSL.UFA.runtime: R >=4.0; IDSL.IPA >=2.7 and readxl; no package compilation in UFA itself. Requires complete R dependency lock at Stage 7.
comparison_requirements: Deferred while raw isotope profiles absent
Freeze isotope database and R dependency versions before execution
